title: Transform Tool
description: This transform tool was made for a university project.
mainText: This transform tool was made for a university project. I wanted to make a transform tool with quality of life systems and a viewport that someone can use whilst not having so manually view the object using their main viewport.

sections.caption: This tool has a viewport, transform utility with singular or multiple objects, renaming, file orginisation, selection tools and tag adding along with getting the details of the objects selected
